sourceBoundary.scope: All 180 production boss records and 247 members; excludes ten authored trainer encounters.
sourceBoundary.unknownPolicy: Unreviewed, approximate, conflicting or incomplete claims remain inferred. Confidence labels and URL presence are metadata, not proof.
sourceBoundary.officialBoundary: Recovered official client code establishes display behavior and client-side conditions only. Exact boss IV/EV/nature, hidden combat stats and server AI were not recovered.
sourceBoundary.periodBoundary: Observed means a specific claim was read in a period gameplay report; it is not official server certification.
sourceBoundary.executionBoundary: Source provenance is separate from data/boss-rule-support-v56.json execution coverage. Implemented does not mean historically exact.
